_about: How ve voice clone voices an off-day voiceover short with his approved ElevenLabs clone (scripts/velib/clone_voice.py). The clone itself, its voice id included, is read live from krish-clone's registry (scripts/velib/lint.py SYNTHETIC_REGISTRY, platform_ref); nothing here keeps a voice id or a key. The key is ELEVENLABS_API_KEY on the machine that generates (docs/INTEGRATIONS.md). The estimate is characters times credits_per_character; the reservation is settled with what ElevenLabs reports (its character-cost header).
ruling: Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-15: off-day voiceover shorts may be voiced with his approved ElevenLabs clone; hero cuts stay on his real takes
